1.answer: The sources disagree. The installation guide (Rev. C, March 2026) says 600 mm for single-layer partitions; the older FAQ (May 2023) says 625 mm. The newer guide should be trusted: 600 mm [plasterboard_installation_guide.md], and fire-rated systems such as FR-90 need 400 mm. The FAQ figure [fire_protection_faq.md] looks outdated.

4.answer: System FR-90: type F 15 mm board in a double layer on both sides of 75 mm steel studs [fire_protection_faq.md], studs at 400 mm centres, screws every 250 mm at edges and 300 mm in the field, second layer offset by at least 400 mm [plasterboard_installation_guide.md]. Ignore the 625 mm in the FAQ for this system.
